defects.summary: If one agy probe is cancelled or throws inside DecidedAsync, the whole round's aggregate is dropped, including codex, claude and kimi decisions that needed no probe; D5 only says a cancelled probe parks nothing.

The default ReadResetAsync runs CooldownParser.StatedReset on Kimi's reason, but D5 and the Kimi plan's D3 say Kimi's reset clause is never parsed and Kimi always parks on a guess; this holds only because today's sample line has nothing the parser can read.
S33 builds the page with the static pageTree parser instead of runPageHtml as the scenario says, and checks the cooldown line with a loose regex instead of the exact S31 line.

S40's negative and above-one fraction rows edit both Gemini buckets and expect GroupMissing, while the plan's case edits one bucket and expects Available; this makes the test stronger, but the change is not in §12.
Product comments cite research/PLAN_a_spent_quota_cools_the_model_down.md, a path that does not exist (the plan is still in todo/), while other new files cite the todo/ path.
modelsTab.ts is changed outside the plan's file list, and unlike the catalogCss and teamServerTab changes it is not recorded among the deviations.

The test classes repeat helpers instead of sharing them: JsonSetup and SpentWithoutReset beside the report tests' Edited and Spend, and Now, Fixture and Agy133Reason defined again although QuotaSamples already has them.

summary: This is a full and faithful build of D1–D12: the build, both suites, format and all 43 scenarios are green. The three-valued verdict, the agy readers and the D3 table, the locked fail-open cooldown file, the per-key aggregation, the roster exclusion, the providers member and the card all match the spec, and §12 records every substantive deviation truthfully (S25's date and S34's split are needed fixes for contradictions inside the plan). The findings are all minor: on cancellation the whole round's aggregate is dropped, Kimi's reset clause can in principle be parsed, S33 uses a weaker harness than the scenario names, S40 departs from the plan without a record, plus some comment-path drift and duplicated test helpers.
